title: eludite.file.close_all input
description: Window > Close All Documents and the tab menu's Close All But This and Close All But Pinned.

except.description: Keep this document open (Close All But This).

keep_pinned.description: Keep pinned tabs open (Close All But Pinned).

save.description: What to do with unsaved changes: save writes them first, discard drops them. Required when any of the documents is dirty: the UI asks the user (Save, Don't Save, Cancel) and passes the answer.
